thread:
jia: Quick check-in: POC for tenant-local CP is green. Two remaining risks: DNS handoff flakiness and cert rotation flooding customer KMS. Short proposals?

noah: DNS: prefer delegation (NS) for ownership but detect partial delegation with multi-resolver probes; if partial, answer synthetic endpoint records from our fallback DNS for up to 5m. Keep TTLs low.

talya: certs: batch rotations per-region with a 30s window + token-bucket per-tenant to cap KMS ops. Emit metrics: batches, avg_latency, kms_errors. If KMS error rate >3% for 2m, pause and alert.

jia: what about customers needing manual allowlist for new certs?

noah: support a "whitelist_required" flag in tenant config. Controller posts webhook with fingerprint and waits; mark op as pending and surface in console.

talya: ops: enforce concurrent-delegation limit (default 3) to avoid wide DNS churn. Also use blue/green weight flips (weight 0 -> 100) gated by health probes.

ops-bot: Note: staged deploy "tenant-local-cp-fallback-dns" scheduled at 2026-03-23T16:40:00Z by jia.

jia: action items: noah -> doc probe heuristics, talya -> cert-controller sketch + metrics, I'll wire fallback DNS in staging. Follow-up next week. :thumbsup:
